# Authentia

> AI strategy and digital change advisory for mid-sized and large organisations in Canada, the United States, and the United Kingdom.

Authentia offers AI strategy, AI and digital change management, workflow and operating model design, practical AI governance, implementation and pilot advisory, and ongoing advisory. Engagements may be focused projects or advisory retainers. Clients and their delivery teams retain responsibility for execution and operation.

The dental technology case describes a limited live rollout in Canada, positive qualitative feedback, and a planned broader US rollout. The banking and marketplace cases describe earlier digital delivery experience.

Free resources are available without registration. Paid resource pages describe the packs and include public samples; purchase availability is shown on each page.

## Services
- [AI strategy and opportunity assessment](https://www.authentia.ca/services/ai-strategy): Prioritise worthwhile AI opportunities, assess readiness and build a practical investment case and roadmap around business value.
- [AI and digital change management](https://www.authentia.ca/services/ai-digital-change-management): Prepare people and workflows for new technology with clear ownership, stakeholder alignment, practical enablement and adoption measures.
- [Workflow and operating model design](https://www.authentia.ca/services/workflow-operating-model): Connect people, systems and AI through practical workflows, clear decision rights, useful handoffs and responsibilities your team can implement.
- [Practical AI governance](https://www.authentia.ca/services/ai-governance): Give teams practical guidance for AI decisions, with clear ownership, review routes, human oversight and escalation alongside your existing specialist functions.
- [Implementation and pilot advisory](https://www.authentia.ca/services/implementation-advisory): Shape a bounded pilot, compare tools and providers, and review delivery plans and evidence before deciding whether to expand.
- [Ongoing AI and digital change advisory](https://www.authentia.ca/services/ongoing-advisory): A continuing advisory relationship for leaders connecting AI priorities, digital change, investment decisions, adoption and practical governance.

## Selected experience
- [From a sales bottleneck to a live AI pilot](https://www.authentia.ca/case-studies/dental-technology-ai-pilot): How Authentia defined and built an AI-assisted lead qualification pilot for a dental technology supplier, with a limited live rollout in Canada.
- [Modernizing a digital banking experience](https://www.authentia.ca/case-studies/financial-services-digital-experience): Selected digital delivery experience supporting the redesign of a financial institution's banking platform through product, design, and engineering collaboration.
- [Supporting a cross-border vehicle marketplace](https://www.authentia.ca/case-studies/cross-border-marketplace): Selected digital delivery experience supporting a vehicle marketplace connecting private sellers and dealerships across Canada and the United States.

## Insights
- [How to choose your first AI use case](https://www.authentia.ca/insights/choosing-your-first-ai-use-case): A practical way to find an AI opportunity with a clear business owner, usable information and a result your team can evaluate.
- [What an AI pilot needs to prove before rollout](https://www.authentia.ca/insights/evaluating-an-ai-pilot-before-rollout): Evaluate the whole workflow, including exceptions, review effort and ownership, before expanding an AI pilot.
- [Should you buy, adapt or build your AI solution?](https://www.authentia.ca/insights/buy-adapt-or-build-ai): Compare ready-made software, configured tools and custom development against the workflow, operating effort and ownership your business needs.
- [From a useful prompt to a reliable business workflow](https://www.authentia.ca/insights/from-prompts-to-reliable-workflows): Give reusable prompts the inputs, reference material, review steps and ownership they need to support everyday work.
- [Why AI adoption needs more than training](https://www.authentia.ca/insights/ai-adoption-beyond-training): Plan the leadership, workflow, communication and learning changes that help employees put AI to work with confidence.
- [How to measure AI value beyond usage](https://www.authentia.ca/insights/measuring-ai-value-beyond-usage): Connect AI adoption with business outcomes, complete operating costs and clear decisions about where to fund, revise or stop.

## Resources
- [AI Opportunity Scorecard](https://www.authentia.ca/resources/ai-opportunity-scorecard): Compare potential AI opportunities using business value, feasibility, data, ownership, risk and testability.
- [Workflow Brief Template](https://www.authentia.ca/resources/workflow-brief-template): Create a shared brief for a specific workflow before evaluating tools or requesting an implementation proposal.
- [Pilot Readiness Checklist](https://www.authentia.ca/resources/pilot-readiness-checklist): Prepare a bounded AI trial with clear ownership, approved inputs, evaluation criteria and a practical fallback.
- [AI Strategy Working Pack](https://www.authentia.ca/resources/ai-strategy-working-pack): Run a structured strategy review, compare opportunities and prepare a roadmap with clear evidence, owners and decision gates.
- [AI Pilot Decision Pack](https://www.authentia.ca/resources/ai-pilot-decision-pack): Prepare a pilot charter, evaluation approach, ownership map and provider handoff, then make a clear expand, revise or stop decision.
- [Change Readiness Starter Kit](https://www.authentia.ca/resources/change-readiness-starter-kit): Assess role impacts, readiness and stakeholder actions before introducing an AI tool or a new digital way of working.
- [AI and Digital Change Working Pack](https://www.authentia.ca/resources/ai-digital-change-working-pack): Connect change impacts, sponsor decisions, communication, role-based learning and adoption evidence in a practical rollout plan.
- [Workflow Design Starter Kit](https://www.authentia.ca/resources/workflow-design-starter-kit): Map process steps, clarify handoffs and distinguish AI assistance from the decisions people retain before planning a change.
- [Workflow and Operating Model Pack](https://www.authentia.ca/resources/workflow-operating-model-pack): Design future workflows with clear decisions, exception routes, operating ownership, baseline measures and a practical transition review.
- [AI Governance Starter Kit](https://www.authentia.ca/resources/ai-governance-starter-kit): Describe an AI use, clarify information and action boundaries, and prepare a review plan with evidence and accountable owners.
- [Practical AI Governance Pack](https://www.authentia.ca/resources/practical-ai-governance-pack): Build connected AI-use records, role-specific guidance, review responsibilities, supplier questions, oversight arrangements and change decisions.
